name: while_missing_separator
note: Missing separator before a while label must be rejected.

name: do_missing_separator
note: Missing separator before a do-while label must be rejected.

name: while_empty_label
note: A consumed label separator must require an identifier.

name: do_empty_label
note: A consumed label separator must require an identifier.

name: for_empty_label
note: A fourth-clause separator must require an identifier.

name: while_multiple_labels
note: Only one optional label suffix should be accepted.

name: while_numeric_label
note: Label suffix requires an identifier.

name: do_typedef_label
note: Compare type-name restrictions across all three loop parsers.

name: while_typedef_label
note: Compare type-name restrictions across all three loop parsers.

name: for_typedef_label
note: Compare type-name restrictions across all three loop parsers.

name: do_label_after_body
note: The trailing do label must be available while checking its earlier body.

name: loop_variable_same_name
note: Decide whether value identifiers and loop labels have independent namespaces.

name: loop_goto_same_name
note: Ordinary goto labels and loop labels need explicit namespace rules.

name: goto_loop_label_only
note: A loop suffix must not implicitly define a goto destination.

name: break_goto_label_only
note: An ordinary label must not implicitly define a named loop target.

name: loop_label_forward_sibling
note: Named jumps cannot target future sibling loops.

name: loop_label_exited_sibling
note: Named jumps cannot target completed sibling loops.

name: loop_label_other_function
note: Do not leak loop targets across functions.

name: loop_label_nested_function
note: Reset target stacks on function entry even if nested functions parse.

name: loop_label_reuse_siblings
note: Sibling label reuse should follow the chosen lexical label policy.

name: loop_label_duplicate_nested
note: Duplicate active label rejection versus innermost shadowing needs a rule.

name: continue_outer_for_from_switch
note: Named continue must select the outer for update, not switch exit.

name: continue_outer_do
note: Named continue must select the outer do test.

name: break_outer_while_from_switch
note: Named break must leave the outer loop.

name: unbraced_goto_label_loop_body
note: The labeled statement must own its following statement.

name: unbraced_case_loop_body
note: A case-labeled substatement must remain within its loop.

name: do_label_after_labeled_body
note: Trailing loop suffix plus labeled body must parse as one do statement.

name: dangling_else_after_label
note: Label ownership must not detach an if body from its else.

name: while_const_condition_no_semicolon
note: A label cannot be inferred from adjacent identifiers without its delimiter.

name: const_field_whole_assignment
note: Recursively const fields make aggregate assignment nonmodifiable.

name: nested_const_field_assignment
note: Check const subobjects recursively, not only the outer declaration.

name: for_static_object
note: C for declarations restrict storage classes; differs from C++.

name: for_typedef_declaration
note: C for declaration clause cannot declare a typedef.

name: for_function_declaration
note: C for declaration clause cannot declare a function.

name: function_initializer
note: A function declaration cannot have an initializer.

name: prototype_incomplete_parameter
note: Allow incomplete by-value types in prototypes when the chosen rules permit them.

name: definition_incomplete_parameter
note: An incomplete parameter type cannot be used in the definition.

name: prototype_incomplete_return
note: A prototype can precede completion of its return type.

name: pointer_array_incomplete_element
note: A pointer does not rescue an array with incomplete element type.

name: parameter_top_const_compatibility
note: Ignore top-level parameter const for signature compatibility, retain it in the body.

name: parameter_pointee_const_conflict
note: Pointee const remains part of the function parameter type.

name: parameter_array_pointer_compatibility
note: Array parameters adjust to pointers before signature comparison.

name: parameter_inner_bound_conflict
note: Array-parameter adjustment preserves inner dimensions.

name: zero_null_expression
note: C null pointer constant recognition uses eligible zero integral constant expressions.

name: zero_variable_not_null_constant
note: An ordinary zero-valued variable is not a C null pointer constant.

name: const_local_not_c_ice
note: Const object and integer constant expression differ in C11 and C++.

name: case_comma_not_ice
note: C integer constant-expression rules constrain operators, not only foldability.

name: case_unevaluated_call
note: Check C11 integer-constant-expression operand restrictions as well as unevaluated-operator exceptions; do not use runtime foldability alone.

name: vla_initializer
note: C11 forbids initializing a VLA; policy differs by version/feature support.

name: vla_static_storage
note: C VLA objects cannot have static storage duration.

name: vm_pointer_file_scope
note: A variably modified pointer type has scope restrictions even though the pointer size is fixed.

name: vla_struct_member
note: Variably modified aggregate members need deliberate rejection or extension rules.

name: void_return_void_expression
note: C11 disallows an expression in void return; C++ has a void-expression exception.

name: label_before_declaration
note: A version choice: declaration after a label changes in C23.

name: label_at_block_end
note: A version choice: a label at block end changes in C23.

name: empty_aggregate_initializer
note: Empty brace initialization is version/language dependent.

name: goto_into_vla_scope
note: C has specific restrictions on entering variably modified scopes.

name: switch_enters_vla_scope
note: Switch case entry has variably modified scope restrictions.

name: typedef_vla_redefinition
note: Compatible repeated typedef exemption excludes variably modified types in C11.

name: assign_aggregate_with_array_member
note: Whole arrays are unassignable but a struct containing an array can be assignable.

name: short_circuit_typecheck
note: Unevaluated operands still need name/type checking.

name: sizeof_typechecks_identifier
note: Unevaluated sizeof still needs identifier resolution.

name: pointer_relational_null
note: Relational pointer constraints differ from pointer equality with null.

name: pointer_equality_null
note: Valid null equality provides a nearby control.

name: function_pointer_relational
note: C relational pointer constraints do not admit function pointers.

name: conditional_void_pointer_qualification
note: Conditional pointer result must combine pointee qualifiers.

name: aggregate_condition
note: No implicit scalar condition for plain aggregates without conversion support.

name: array_size_self_scope
note: A declared identifier enters scope after its declarator, not before its array bound.

name: label_value_same_name
note: C ordinary identifiers and goto labels use separate namespaces.

name: unbraced_switch
note: C permits a switch body that is a statement rather than a brace block.

name: ternary_middle_comma
note: The middle conditional operand is an expression and may contain an unparenthesized comma.

name: main_float_return
note: Hosted main signature validation is distinct from requiring a main in every unit.

name: main_bad_parameter
note: Hosted main parameter restrictions require an explicit execution-model policy.

name: sizeof_vla_bound_side_effect
note: VLA sizeof can evaluate bounds; blanket unevaluated-sizeof handling would be incorrect.

name: sizeof_vla_frozen_extent
note: A VLA instance retains the extent established at declaration.

name: static_pointer_to_vla
note: A block-scope static pointer to VLA differs from a static VLA object.

name: aggregate_function_member
note: C forbids function-typed members; baka may intentionally treat this as a method declaration.

name: flexible_array_member
note: Flexible arrays require parser support plus placement and containment restrictions if enabled.

name: bitfield_member
note: Bit-fields are not currently represented in member declarations; scope decision required.

name: designated_initializer
note: Designated initialization is separate grammar and needs a deliberate support decision.

name: duplicate_enum_values_valid
note: Duplicate enum numeric values can be legal even though duplicate names are not.

name: function_empty_list_argument
note: C11 empty prototype syntax differs from C23 and C++ zero-parameter syntax.

name: for_body_shadow_initializer
note: C and C++ differ on redeclaring the for variable in the outermost body block.

name: for_body_typedef_leak
note: Ensure any supported for-declared type ends scope after the loop.
